paper_title: Gut-associated microbes are present and active in the pig nasal cavity
skip_reason: No disease group vs. healthy control comparison. The study exclusively samples 24 healthy piglets from three farms without respiratory disease outbreaks and examines the prevalence, source, and activity of gut-microbiota associated taxa (Bacteroidales and Clostridiales) in the nasal cavity compared to rectal samples. No diseased cohort is present; this is a descriptive characterization study of healthy animal microbiota.
